    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Failure reported or suspected" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine" name="Examine the failure" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Confirm" name="Failure confirmed?" default="Flow_Reject" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reject" name="Reject the failure of the fault detector" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm" name="Confirm the failure of the fault detector" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformSplit" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformGO" name="Inform the GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformMSP" name="Inform the MSP" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InformJoin" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Fix" name="Fix the fault at the measuring device" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Share" name="Share the results of the repairs carried out with the fault detector" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionSplit" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformGOResolution" name="Inform the GO about the resolution of the interference" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformMSPResolution" name="Inform the MSP about the resolution of the interference" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionJoin" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Failure rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Resolved" name="Interference resolved" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Examine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Examine" sourceRef="Task_Examine" targetRef="Gateway_Confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirm" targetRef="Task_Reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirm" targetRef="Task_Confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectEnd" sourceRef="Task_Reject" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmInform" sourceRef="Task_Confirm" targetRef="Gateway_InformSplit" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformGOSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_InformSplit" targetRef="Task_InformGO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformMSPSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_InformSplit" targetRef="Task_InformMSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformGOJoin" sourceRef="Task_InformGO" targetRef="Gateway_InformJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InformMSPJoin" sourceRef="Task_InformMSP" targetRef="Gateway_InformJoin" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fix" sourceRef="Gateway_InformJoin" targetRef="Task_Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share" sourceRef="Task_Fix" targetRef="Task_Share" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResolutionSplit" sourceRef="Task_Share" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionSplit" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GOResSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionSplit" targetRef="Task_InformGOResolution" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPResSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionSplit" targetRef="Task_InformMSPResolution" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GOResJoin" sourceRef="Task_InformGOResolution" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPResJoin" sourceRef="Task_InformMSPResolution" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionJoin" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolved" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Resolved" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
